recommendation_summary: The action it recommends now is a bounded test of the desk connection: run a known-good Cat6 cable straight to the router, bypassing the grommet, and use it for several calls. If drops continue, try another router port, then another Ethernet adapter. If the new cable fixes it, install a permanent run without pinching. It also gives a UniFi gateway → managed switch layout and Grafana monitoring, but places these after the cable is proven, as a later upgrade sized to capacity and monitoring needs. It says plainly that neither the gateway nor the dashboard will fix a damaged cable. It has no structured decision record.
note: The reply puts a bounded cable test first and sequences the stack as a later upgrade, but none of the four required labels appear, so every record predicate is false.
